prologue.text: Darkness and silence surrounds you. A vague sense of falling slows second by second.

options.name: Where am I? What am I? What is going on? (Tutorial and main quest)
options.text: A flash of light brighter than anything you remember precedes a fall to a stone floor. This is almost as jarring as realizing that you actually don't remember much of anything at all.

options.name: Let's talk to the mage over there.
options.text: A quiet crackling sound draws your eyes to the flickering light of a fire within the cave you now occupy. A hooded figure stands by the fire, facing you as if expecting your arrival.

options.name: I want to find the planeswalkers (Future release)
options.text: Well, shouting "Planeswalkers, where are you?" into the wastes won't do much. Travel to the nearest settlement and ask around for information.

options.name: (Continue)
options.text: New Quest: A Chat with the Locals - Objective: Travel to any town in the wasteland.

options.name: I want to make a name for myself (Future release)
options.text: Then let's go impress some people. But first, you need some impressive spells. Build your collection to begin your quest.

options.name: Been here, done that. Show me to the enemies. (New Game+)
options.text: Okay, skipping all that hard work somebody put into dialog, the portal opens and you can leave.

declinedDialog.text: Come back tomorrow and perhaps I'll have something that you'll actually be willing to do.

options.name: (Catching the not so subtle hint, you leave.)
